description: Source code for a tokenizer component used in a build system or parser, handling token classification, string parsing, operator recognition, and error reporting.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A class responsible for tokenizing input text into a sequence of tokens, handling classification, whitespace, and error detection.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the tokenization process on the input file, returning a vector of tokens.

methods.name: ClassifyToken
methods.description: Classifies a character (and its following character) into a token type.

methods.name: AdvanceToEndOfToken
methods.description: Advances the current position to the end of the current token based on its type.
